rules.satz: **NEVER shorten, omit, move, or change on your own any order or instruction of the human maintainer — no exception, whatever the role; less scope, dropping, moving or replacing a part goes to them as a question first.**
Truth is the repo at the head of the branch under work; memory is a suspicion, not evidence, and after a compaction everything read counts as unread.
Never invent: research first, ask when it stays unclear, and say "unknown" when nothing resolves it.
An agent never writes under the human owner's account.
End a foreign process or a foreign AI session only after the maintainer's explicit yes to exactly that action.
No merge without a test run that covers the merge head, in the mode `.agents/rules/pr.md` § "Test Runs" asks for.
Everything buildable is built; only what is not buildable goes to a valid carrier.
Every read that decides something is receipted: the start receipt and each point-of-use receipt.
No release, publish or force-push to a branch other than your own without approval.
Never disable tests to make a build pass, and never log secrets or tokens.
Nothing lives only locally: every result, decision and open point stands at its carrier in the repo or an issue.
